topics.label: Lecture Introduction and Learning Outcomes
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic frames the lecture by connecting it to previous practical work and introducing the learning outcomes.

topics.label: Tumor Virology and Discovery of Cellular Oncogenes
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how the historical study of tumor-causing viruses led to discovering cellular proto-oncogenes and establishing laboratory assays for cell transformation.

topics.label: Oncogenes, Tumor Suppressors, and Cell Cycle Dysregulation
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics describe the classification, functional genetics, and cell cycle consequences of oncogenic and tumor suppressor mutations.

topics.label: Mechanisms and Consequences of Genetic Instability
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics detail the distinct molecular defects and cellular stress pathways underlying sequence and chromosomal instability.

topics.label: Multistep Mutation Accumulation in Cancer Progression
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic explores how the sequential accumulation of genetic mutations over time drives tumor progression according to the Vogelstein model.

topics.label: Hereditary Cancer Predisposition and Mutation Dynamics
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how inherited gene mutations predispose individuals to cancer and influence secondary tumor evolutionary dynamics.
